U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.en: Clauseo won't work in this matter while another matter's folder is inside its folder. Your question is kept.
U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.hi: जब तक किसी दूसरे मामले का फ़ोल्डर इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर के अंदर है, Clauseo इस मामले में काम नहीं करेगा। आपका प्रश्न रखा गया है।
U3-err-matter.holds_other_matter.note: matter.holds_other_matter: the turn's stop line when another matter on Clauseo's list lies inside this matter's folder (folders moved outside Clauseo); at a launch, a resume or before a prompt. The question is kept; the UC-387 notice before it names the matter

UC-387.en: {matter} is inside this matter's folder. Move {matter}'s folder out of it, or remove one of the two matters from Clauseo.
UC-387.hi: {matter} इस मामले के फ़ोल्डर के अंदर है। {matter} का फ़ोल्डर इससे बाहर ले जाएँ, या दोनों में से एक मामले को Clauseo से हटा दें।
UC-387.note: Host notice NoticeKind::MatterInside, given with each turn refused matter.holds_other_matter: {matter} is the inner matter by its name now, bidi-isolated; what to do is move its folder out, or remove one of the two matters from Clauseo
